thesis: Deterministic gates should support Berkshire as a Buffett-style value holding rather than an outlier-growth name. Strong liquidity, durable multi-engine earnings and disciplined buybacks offset reinvestment-at-scale risk. A NORMAL allocation is appropriate only if the mechanical archetype and veto gate remain intact after aggregation.
